answer.text: Clearing house or clearing corporation with margining and guaranteed settlement

explanation.text: The Logic: Exchange-traded derivatives are settled through a clearing house or clearing corporation that takes margins and provides guaranteed settlement. The Trap: Bilateral OTC settlement applies to non-exchange contracts; physical-only delivery and email confirmation do not describe exchange settlement. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-A PMS Distributors workbook, p.73, p.75, p.77.
